scope: Read-only source review of current uncommitted durable streaming implementation. No production access; no integration tests run by reviewer.

findings.finding: Native Stop can settle transport before server cancellation acknowledgement, racing commit against running status.
findings.observedFix: stopReceipt is awaited before settling; running cancellation conflicts get specific feedback. Stop failure still preserves recovery rather than proving cancellation.
findings.verification: Hold Stop response and transition; abort native signal; assert no commit before confirmed Stop and one provider invocation.

findings.finding: Reload parses failed provider HTTP response without native !response.ok handling, risking empty assistant commit.
findings.verification: Reload retained HTTP500 job; preserve baseline, show provider failure, do not commit empty assistant or consume replay.

findings.finding: Native transcript write followed by receipt persistence failure can leave unacknowledged job; new-page replay changes timestamps and exact candidate hash, causing permanent CAS conflict.
findings.parentPlan: Server worker adding write-ahead pending hash and reconciliation. Not yet inspected as present.
findings.verification: Fail receipt persistence after transcript write, reload NEW PAGE and reconcile without rewriting text/timestamps or leaving blocked job.

findings.finding: OpenAI parser.n captured before actual generation parameters, so outer {prompt} always records n1 and breaks multiswipe replay.
findings.observedFix: setGenerationParser called after actual parameter assembly with source,n,canMultiSwipe,showThoughts; restored parser uses explicit canMultiSwipe.
findings.verification: Generate n2 interleaved choices, reload while active/completed, assert alternatives remain separate and finish counts correct.

findings.finding: onFinishStreaming failed save returned early, caller still triggered auto-continue and returned success to cast queue.
findings.observedFix: Parent reports failure now throws to queue error path; inspect/run after parent integration complete.
findings.verification: Fail commit with auto-continue enabled and cast queue; assert no next inference or tool execution and retained output retryable.

findings.finding: New job permitted while same story has completed-but-unacknowledged output; restore jobs.find selects old job.
findings.parentPlan: Server worker changing guard to unresolved same-story work.
findings.verification: Complete job without commit; new ID same story rejected until acknowledged; other story remains available.

findings.finding: Start request retries fetch only; a dropped202 JSON body after headers loses acknowledgement despite running server job.
findings.verification: Return202+job header then reset JSON body; retry same idempotent ID or query it, provider invocation remains one.

findings.finding: Acknowledged receipts retain job.sink/job.socket and native close-listener closures, which can retain request/context and buffers for seven days despite record.context=null.
evidence: src/generation-jobs.js acknowledge only replaces record and removes journal
src/generation-jobs.js GenerationResponse._destroy does not close socket after normal finish
src/util.js forwardFetchResponse to.socket.close closure retains upstream body and sink
src/endpoints/backends/text-completions.js native request.socket.close closure retains detached request
findings.verification: After completed job acknowledgement, assert active timer and sink/socket references/listeners are released; provider already complete and receipt idempotency still works.

remainingIntegrationQuestions: Native pending/unsaved job guards must block story mutation and native autosave races, not only workspace buttons.
Original browser orchestration for tools/cast remains intentionally unreplayed after reload; assert no duplicate side effects.
New-page recovery must be exercised through real native provider routers, not only fake Writable dispatch or transport mocks.
